items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The best time keeping drummer I ever had, ever played, was with Hendrick Martin.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I was going to ask a minute ago about Joe Lindsey. Was he really such a good drummer? He never played in late years, you know, and so he gave up music.

Yeah, much time. No, very good. He really liked him, huh? The best time keeping drummer I ever had, ever played, was with Hendrick Martin. Yeah, he'd been to your drummer for years. Oh boy. Guy had an idea. Any number you'd play with, any little funny lyrics to it or something, that would mean a bird or a rabbit or a rat, anything, he'd get some kind of instrument to imitate it, you know. A little track. Yeah, fill in, you know. Like a cow, you know. Good coloration. Yeah. Oh yeah, a big bag full of that stuff.…
Well, just one second. I was going to ask, I'll finish up to the Henry Martin business. How come he wasn't with you? Did he live long or was he dead by that time?
